_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_entered_this_turn_filter.py. t_ett_zurgo is Zurgo and Ojutai's second line -- hexproof as long as IT entered this turn -- and t_ett_zurgo_ledger is the same card written with the value leaf instead, which is the narrowest thing sayable without the filter key: 'an Orc Dragon you control entered this turn'. It is kept live so the difference between 'this permanent entered' and 'some matching permanent did' is measured rather than asserted in a comment. t_ett_neriv is Neriv, Heart of the Storm's replacement, and t_ett_gratuitous is the same static with the temporal clause dropped -- the approximation the gap record refused. t_ett_dragon is a plain Orc Dragon to be the other one, and t_ett_bear an ordinary creature to deal damage with.
